title: Hives from deformed GUE minor processes
summary: We construct random hives from deformed GUE minor processes. Starting from two independent diagonally deformed GUE matrices \[ X=\sqrt{n}(wG+uD),\qquad Y=\sqrt{n}(w'G'+u'D'), \] where \(D,D'\) are diagonal and have GUE spectra, we use their minor processes to form a double hive and then apply the octahedron recurrence. Under the matching condition \[ \frac{u}{w^2}=\frac{u'}{(w')^2}, \] we prove that the resulting hive law is close, in relative entropy, to a GUE hive law.
